source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The scheduler checks active state, document visibility, focused window and screen bounds for the explicit currentWindow or the active window. _checkScreen returns true on Linux because positions are unreliable; elsewhere it compares the window rectangle with available screen bounds and a120px allowance. It does not detect another window covering Thunderbird. Startup active-state initialization uses idleTime<5000, separately from the 30-second idle observer. These checked limits qualify documentation about visibility; they do not establish user exposure, attribution, full multiwindow dismissal behavior or native results. No notification ran.
title: Notification visibility documentation needs the scheduler platform limits
